lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular grid of high-intensity white pixel clusters located posterior to the gill slits along the lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of increased luminance intersecting with horizontal rows of white blobs, forming a discernible grid structure on the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Horizontal linear features on the upper third of the flank characterized by a high-contrast luminance gradient with bright upper edges and darker shadowed lower regions.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 10 distinct high-luminance spots scattered across the visible surface area of the first dorsal fin.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple associated teleost fish silhouettes clustered near the ventral and mid-lateral regions of the primary subject.
